title: Request calls containing foo
description: Reports request call regions that contain the foo marker.
rationale: This example demonstrates independent predicates over a shared regex query.

contains-foo.help: Review the request marker and use the documented form.

limitations: This example only inspects text files and does not interpret request arguments.

code.source: for matched in rx::find_all(file, "request") { if matched.text.contains("foo") { emit(matched.span, "contains-foo"); } }
